name: Molt care specialist
design: Stocky muscular female Yautja, blue-grey spotted hide, rounded broad alien brow, four clearly separated mandibular arms, short clustered black scalp tendrils in a low knot. Earth-red utility vest over cream linen shirt, thick charcoal knee apron, two small bronze tins on belt, bare clawed feet. Holds a long soft grooming mitt draped over one forearm and a broad flat wooden scraper with blunt edge lowered at side. No animal skin or body part.
